title: DPE crates: RustCrypto 2026, caliptra-dpe pin alignment, edition-2024 fixes
description: wolfcrypt-dpe bumps its traits. dpe-conformance had been broken since a96a261 (pinned caliptra-dpe 6dfc502 vs cfc9a71); it's aligned now and its verifiers moved to p384 0.14 / x509-cert 0.3. dpe-hw: #[unsafe(no_mangle)], aes 0.9/cbc 0.2/sha2 0.11, and FieldBytes borrows instead of copying.
